title: Chapter 1411
text:
Looking at everyone's dumbfounded expressions, Han Xiaoxin knew that practice was the only way. He released his life level pressure, and a condensed aura gushed out. The air in the room seemed to have turned into a sticky gel, making it difficult for people to move.

A sense of oppression suddenly crashed into the hearts of the many Beyond Grade As. Everyone's expression changed, and they instinctively became nervous. Their nerves tensed up, and the cell furnace in their bodies crazily pumped energy, like wild cats that were about to explode in the face of an enemy.

Right at this moment, the pressure disappeared like a receding tide, and the high-level pressure of a Transcendent was retracted.

Only then did everyone come back to their senses and could not sit still anymore.

"Black Star, how did you do it?" Someone was shocked.

"Quick, tell us how to break through to the Transcendent Grade!" Someone could not wait.

"I didn't expect … I didn't expect a higher level to really exist. I thought that Beyond Grade A was the limit of an individual's strength …" someone muttered.

Most of the Beyond Grade As were in an uproar. This was no different from the Calamity Grade students who had pestered Fu Ding when he advanced to the Beyond Grade A realm. They were all filled with eager desire.

Facing the questions of the crowd, Han Xiao waved his hand and casually said, "The failure rate of advancement is very high. I was just lucky."

Hearing this, Secret Master wisely chose to shut up and did not dare refute.

To everyone, Black Star's advancement was too sudden, and it was difficult for them to digest this fact. Other than a few people who knew about it, most of the Beyond Grade As could not suppress the shock in their hearts.

Generations of geniuses in history had not been able to break through the limit of individual strength. Many people even thought that Beyond Grade A was the limit of individual strength. They did not expect Black Star to not only break through it, but also at such a young age.

Although they knew that Black Star was the most accomplished Super in history, whether he broke this publicly acknowledged limit or not was completely different.

At this moment, in everyone's eyes, Han Xiao was a glowing guide, a pioneer, and his image became taller once again.

"You …" Manison wanted to say something, but stopped.

Black Star had opened up a new level without revealing anything, which made him feel very complicated.

Originally, although Black Star was strong, they were still at the same level. Although Manison was much more relaxed now, he still had some unwillingness to admit defeat in his heart. If there was a chance, he still wanted to catch up and compete.

But now, the height of the two had been completely pulled apart, and a fundamental gap had appeared.

Manison had seen how Black Star had caught up with him step by step, then left him far behind. Until now, he couldn't even see the other's back. Even though he had a firm heart, he couldn't help but feel a sense of loss.

At this moment, Kant spoke.

"Black Star, you don't have to be humble. If not for you, this boundary would probably still be an insurmountable obstacle in the eyes of the entire Beyond Grade As."

His tone was filled with envy, but it was also filled with excitement.

The other Beyond Grade As were similar. There were definitely some who were envious and jealous, and there were also quite a few who were jealous. However, most of them thought that there was someone to rely on!

If it was an unfamiliar, neutral Beyond Grade A who had reached a new level, they would definitely be extremely envious and would want nothing more than to replace him. However, if this pioneer was Black Star, they would be able to accept it and be happy.

On one hand, Black Star's reputation among the Beyond Grade As had reached an unprecedented level. On the other hand, because of his identity as the leader of the association, he had obtained so many benefits for the Beyond Grade As. He had long been one of them in the eyes of everyone.

Due to Black Star's methods and the temptation of the Sanctums, the Beyond Grade As had formed a close community of interests. As a group, the stronger the leader, the more weight the Beyond Grade As would have in the universe.

Furthermore, Black Star was the source of the Sanctum Revival. The stronger he was, the more secure the revival would be. Naturally, it was worth everyone's joy. In addition, many Beyond Grade As believed that Black Star, as the leader of the association, would more or less impart some experience in breaking through. No matter how they thought about it, there was no harm in it.

After understanding all these, most of the Beyond Grade As present became more and more excited. They looked at Han Xiao with even more admiration.

Not only did Black Star bring about the Sanctum Revival, but he also pointed out the direction of individual strength. Everyone felt that his position as the leader had never been as justified as it was now.

Han Xiao glanced at everyone's excited, reverent, and admiring expressions, smiled, and said, "Everyone knows this well.

Don't spread it around. By the way, the upper echelons of the three Universal Civilizations already know about it. Don't worry about them … As for the Promotion method that everyone is concerned about, I also happened to succeed. I still need to familiarize myself with the power of the new grade. When I have a stable Promotion idea, I'll share it. Forget it for now. "

Beyoni's eyes lit up. "Will you tell all of us for free?"

"… Guess." Han Xiao glanced at him as if he was looking at a lifetime member of the Peach Blossoms Network.

"I guess not." Beyoni smiled awkwardly.

"Then you're really smart."

Han Xiao rolled his eyes.

Hearing this, the Beyond Grade As present did not have any objections. The method to advance to the Transcendent Grade was so precious. If it were them, they would not easily publicize it.

Kasuyi, who was at the side, felt that Wuornos had already grasped the method to advance. It did not seem to be useful for the association to keep it a secret, but he would not jump out to object.

With his current trust in Han Xiao, he felt that Han Xiao's every move had a deeper meaning.

This time, Beiger could not help but ask, "I wonder if we can see the power of the Transcendent Grade …"

Before he could finish, Han Xiao interrupted him and waved his hand.

"The war isn't over yet. You'll see it sooner or later. I won't show it now."

Hearing this, everyone could only nod.

Han Xiao looked around. Seeing that someone was about to speak, he immediately said, "Everyone, today is just to announce this matter and let everyone understand the situation. The regular meeting will end here. Everyone, you can leave. I still have some things to arrange."

Everyone was stunned. Originally, they still had a lot of questions to ask, but seeing that Han Xiao did not seem to want to answer, they could only swallow these questions back into their stomachs.

The Beyond Grade As stood up and bade farewell, walking out of the conference room with excitement that had yet to dissipate.

Now that both sides were no longer Supers of the same level, they subconsciously became more obedient to Han Xiao's orders, and their mentality vaguely changed.

Han Xiao watched as the Beyond Grade As left one by one, but there were still some who did not leave. Hella and the other army officers surrounded him, shocked.

They hadn't received any concrete information beforehand, so they were just as surprised as the others when they suddenly found out.

"Come, let's go for a few rounds and let me experience a higher level of strength." Hella went straight to the point, full of fighting spirit.

"Move aside, I'm not in the mood to torture you today."

Han Xiao angrily pressed her face and pushed her to the side.

Fuding turned a blind eye to this and sincerely congratulated, "Congratulations."

After saying that, he could not help but sigh. He had thought that after advancing to the Beyond Grade A realm, he had caught up to Black Star's footsteps slightly, but a moment of carelessness had widened the gap again.

Han Xiao smiled and nodded, not saying anything, only patting his shoulder.

This time, Ames came up and smiled. "What do you plan to do next?"

"Plan? Just like before, continue to prepare for war. " Han Xiao replied. Suddenly, he thought of something and said, "However, in terms of private matters, I want to have children."

Ames raised her brows. "With who?"

"Are you willing?"

Ames hesitated for a moment and shook her head.

"Then I'll have to think of another way." Han Xiao spread his hands and said regretfully.

"What are you going to do?" Hearing this, Ames narrowed her eyes.

"I'm going to see if I can use my cells to breed some test tube babies through genetic modification." Han Xiao turned to look at the dumbfounded Aurora and said, "Also, using my blood to fuse with her life energy, I should be able to mass produce children."

"… Up to you then." Ames regained her composure and shook her head with a smile. "Your idea of reproduction is really like a Mechanic."

"What do you mean by like? I'm a Mechanic. "Han Xiao did not mind." Industrialization is the way to go. "

War was imminent, and there was definitely not enough time to breed one by one. He needed a batch of high-quality Supers who had inherited the talents of his race. There was no point in having too few of them.

In order to obtain a large enough inherited race, the normal method was to turn into a breeding pig and mate crazily with the mutants of the native race. Basically, only males could do that. However, Han Xiao was not interested in that and decided to mass produce his offspring using the Mechanic method. He did not need to capture the females of other races like Beast Ancestor. He could reproduce asexually and be self-sufficient.

Although the descendants cultivated this way were more standardized, it was worth a try. After all, he had such a good racial talent but didn't expand it. In his opinion, it was a waste of resources. Anyway, he didn't lack money or people. Raising a race was a piece of cake.

Han Xiao did not mention this matter anymore. He turned to look at Hella and said, "Don't return to the Soul Terminal for the time being. I have something for you to do."

"What is it?" Hella was curious.

"Get rid of EsGod," Han Xiao said concisely.

Hella's eyes flashed, and she immediately understood what he meant. She narrowed her eyes and said, "EsGod is quite a powerful combatant. If he enters the Underworld, he should immediately become the strongest among the Heroic Spirits. Furthermore, without the restrictions of the genetic chain, he will probably be even stronger than when he was alive!"

"That's it." Han Xiao nodded.

He had never underestimated EsGod. Even among the peak Beyond Grade As, the complete EsGod was still an extremely strong member. What Han Xiao valued the most was the Esper Ability in EsGod's body — [Esper Silence]!

This was the nemesis of almost all Espers. Back then, he had relied on this Character Summon Card to make EsGod fail miserably.

Now that the flames of war were burning in the World Tree, this trump card should not be buried. He felt that it was time for this trump card to see the light of day again.

Fu Ding blinked and said in confusion, "Strange, the dynasty shouldn't be happy to see the Underworld continue to grow. Why would they agree to this request?"

Han Xiao smiled and spread his hands.

"That's because I gave them a reason they couldn't refuse."

Di di di!

At this moment, the communicator suddenly rang.

Han Xiao paused and took out the communicator to take a look. Suddenly, his eyes lit up.

The few of them had been paying attention to his expression and could not help but lean in to see the content.

"What happened? Why are you so happy?" Aurora was curious.

Han Xiao put away the communicator and laughed in a good mood.

"Things have changed for the better these few days. I didn't expect to have a new Deputy Army Commander in the army!"

Everyone was energized.

"Hardaway, Jotina, or Lagi?" Fu Ding guessed.

"None of them." Han Xiao smiled and shook his head. "This guy is called Evans. Let's go and meet him."

Hearing this, everyone was shocked and looked at each other.

Evans? Among the Beyond Grade A seeds who joined later, there did not seem to be such a person. They did not know him. Could it be that he was secretly nurtured by the Army Commander?

…

On the other side, on a desolate planet in the Black Star Corps' territory.

Streams of light flashed, and Han Xiao, Fu Ding, and the others arrived outside the atmosphere. They immediately discovered the source of the energy fluctuations on the planet. It was the final transformation process of a Calamity Grade becoming a Beyond Grade A. They had all experienced this before, so they were naturally very familiar with it.

Han Xiao adjusted his vision, and his gaze penetrated the vortex-like energy. He clearly saw Evans in the center and could not help but reveal a satisfied smile.

First, Fu Ding became a Beyond Grade A, and Evans followed closely behind. Evans had not been a Super for as long as Fu Ding, which meant that he had used a shorter time to become a Beyond Grade A, and his talent was more outstanding.

The 'Second Generation EsGod Nurturing Plan' that had been set decades ago was more than half successful, and only the last step was left.

"I originally wanted to deal with Gaud after some time, but since Evans has already become a Beyond Grade A, it's just nice to deal with him together with EsGod."

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

…

Ancient Star Desert, Holy Covenant …

"What, Black Star has opened up a new level of strength?"

Oathkeeper was stunned.

As an important partner, he was naturally not an outsider. With Han Xiao's approval, Beiger had already sent the news to Holy Covenant.

Hearing this, compared to the shock and excitement of the Holy Covenant Beyond Grade As, Oathkeeper's vision darkened.

Sh * t, I've completely become someone else's underling. There's no hope for me to make a comeback!
